name: del1_tau
label: delta1 Tauri (Hyadum II, K0 III red clump, Hyades)
sources: Boyajian et al. 2009, ApJ 691, 1243 (CHARA Classic, K' band): theta_LD = 2.408 +/- 0.038 mas
SIMBAD: B V (Ducati 2002 / Oja 1993), H (2MASS), K (Ducati 2002)
Boyajian et al. 2009 Table 3: T_eff, log g range, radius; masses 2.48-2.70 Msun
notes: The atmosphere block names the nearest real NewEra giant model from the 2026-11-01 cool-giant box (4500-5500 K x log g 2.0-3.5, [M/H] 0; P. Hauschildt, NERSC): lte04800-2.50-0.0. Earlier campaigns bracketed the star between lte05000-4.50-0.0 (compact) and lte05000-0.00-0.0 (extended) with lte05000-4.50+0.5 for the metallicity (docs/hyades_ld.md); lte04900-2.50+0.5 / lte05000-2.50+0.5 now exist for the +0.15 dex Hyades metallicity.
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets; the B anchor sets the 425 nm flux for the IACT campaigns.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. At 425 nm the first null is at 1.22 lambda / theta.
Mark III 2.338 +/- 0.033 and NPOI 2.21 +/- 0.08 mas gave smaller diameters (Boyajian 2009, Table 4).
